preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 70 and 1 <= M <= 70 and 1 <= K <= 70 for N, M, K in zip(N_list, M_list, K_list))
preconditions.description: For each test case, N, M, and K are between 1 and 70.

postconditions.description: The number of output values matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(S, int) and S >= 1 for S in output_list)
postconditions.description: Each output value S is a positive integer.
